notes: Homonym: shares consonants פשע with H6586 ("rebel; transgress"), already in this dataset -- genuinely unrelated meaning (this root's sole attestation, Isa.27.4, is "I would stride/go through them," unrelated to transgression). Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), this root is פשע¹ and H6586 has been retroactively relabeled פשע² in this same batch.
